_scenario.title: bitcube is offline
_scenario.description: The mini can't open a TCP connection to bitcube over Tailscale, the seasons page can't be fetched (fetch failed) and the SSH probe fails (exit 255: "can't reach bitcube over SSH"); that probe error is 400 s old. Nothing behind bitcube can be checked: not TouchDesigner, the ropes, the boxes, the panels, the cameras, the router or the internet at Gray Area. Dave's agent is fine (the mini reaches Modal directly). No camera stills: they are fetched through bitcube.

expect.headline: bitcube is offline: nothing behind it can be checked

items.bitcube: down: not reachable over Tailscale (TCP 22); the probe has failed for 400 s
items.seasons: unknown: the fetch failed because bitcube is down, not because the file is not running
items.modal agent: ok: reachable from the mini, ticked a minute ago

expect.action: Someone at Gray Area checks bitcube's power light and the router; a restart takes about a minute and bitcube comes back by itself. Nothing can be done from here, and every control would fail.
